facts.fact: MTN Nigeria unveiled phase one of its Sifiso Dabengwa data centre in Ikeja, Lagos (4.5MW, with cloud infrastructure with Dell Technologies, marketed to businesses) on 1 July 2025.
MTN Nigeria describes phase one of the Sifiso Dabengwa data centre, unveiled 1 July 2025, as a Tier 3 data centre (operator's statement; no certifier named).
